summary: Willow Lane Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that, ahead of its business combination with Boost Run Holdings, LLC, no redemptions were requested by holders of its Class A ordinary shares. This indicates strong shareholder support for the deal. The SPAC expects to close the combination shortly. The absence of redemptions eliminates a key closing condition and avoids cash leakage from the trust. Investors should watch for the formal closing announcement and any post-close trading performance of the combined entity as the risk-arb angle centers on deal certainty given zero redemptions.
